title: A Cellar for the House
author: Bram Ishikawa
blurb: Gideon Okonkwo, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
